extensions.source: assets/css/tokens.css defines every colour, font, size, bevel, layout and motion token for :root (light) and :root[data-theme="dark"]. Frontmatter keys prefixed dark- are the dark-theme values of the same custom properties.

illustrationColors.purpose: Used only by the instant answer each names (weather glyphs and chart, rate chart, Breakout brick rows).

display.purpose: Clocks, timer and current temperature (timer digits and random number in Courier Prime at the same size).

headline.purpose: Topic-panel title, settings title, dictionary headword; calculator readout in mono.

title.purpose: Result titles (wrap, matched terms bold), search field text; section headings at 700.

body-sm.purpose: Topic-panel prose and facts, about-this-result box.

label.purpose: Redaction 35: buttons, tabs, status line, toolbar links, footer, result numbers.

label-xs.purpose: Source lines, dates, small underlined text buttons.

mono.purpose: Courier Prime: result addresses, panel website, readouts, chart axes.

shadows.name: raised-plate
shadows.value: border: 2px solid; border-color: var(--bevel-hi) var(--bevel-lo) var(--bevel-lo) var(--bevel-hi); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--bevel-deep)
shadows.purpose: Things you read about: answer cards, topic panel, tab pages, about box, error box, toast.

shadows.name: raised-control
shadows.value: border: 2px solid; border-color: var(--bevel-hi) var(--bevel-deep) var(--bevel-deep) var(--bevel-hi); box-shadow: inset -1px -1px 0 var(--bevel-lo)
shadows.purpose: Things you press: buttons, keys, tabs, range and day buttons.

shadows.name: raised-control-pressed
shadows.value: border-color: var(--bevel-deep) var(--bevel-hi) var(--bevel-hi) var(--bevel-deep); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 var(--bevel-lo); background: var(--pressed)
shadows.purpose: Pressed or selected state; the label shifts 1px down-right via padding.

shadows.name: sunken
shadows.value: border: 2px solid; border-color: var(--bevel-lo) var(--bevel-lit) var(--bevel-lit) var(--bevel-lo); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 var(--bevel-deep)
shadows.purpose: Where you type or look: fields, wells, calculator display, progress tracks. Image frames and chart wells use the border without the inset line.

shadows.name: groove
shadows.value: border-top: 1px solid var(--bevel-lo) with a 1px var(--bevel-hi) line below (box-shadow)
shadows.purpose: Toolbar bottom edge, footer top edge, settings section heads, topic-panel source divider, time-answer divider.

focus.purpose: Every focusable element; default buttons swap their 1px outline for it on focus.

motion.name: book-rock
motion.value: rotate(-7deg) at 35%, back to 0deg at 100%; 700ms var(--ease-out); once; transform-origin 0% 100% on the fill box
motion.purpose: The one brand motion: the lockup's leaning blue book (path fill rgb(103,193,255)) rocks once while results load. Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: tool-feedback
motion.value: coin 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); dice 360ms var(--ease-out); finished timer blinks 1s steps(2)
motion.purpose: Functional feedback inside instant answers only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations forced to 1ms, iteration count 1

breakpoints.name: panel-moves
breakpoints.note: max-width; topic panel moves after the first result

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: max-width; toolbar stacks and stops sticking, page margin 14px, lead-in 38px

breakpoints.name: home-stack
breakpoints.note: max-width; homepage Search button moves below the field

logo.darkMode: Inlined by assets/js/logo.js; paths without an inline rgb fill (the black parts) take currentColor = --ink. The fallback is hidden in dark mode. Coloured parts never change.
logo.rejected: Extending the shelf across the page or toolbar (owner rejected; never reintroduce).

extensions.imagery: Always full colour in sunken frames. No greyscale, dithering, tint or filter (owner: when style affects usability there is a problem). Logos and drawings in the topic panel are contained, not cropped.
divergencesFromContract: Contract motion grammar says "one moment only". Code also has functional tool motion (coin flip 1.1s, dice shake 360ms, finished-timer blink) and a 200ms settings toast transition. Recorded as code: one brand motion plus tool feedback.
Contract lists a white bevel highlight. Code uses bevel-lit #d2d2d2 for the lit edge of sunken things (white vanishes on the white page); raised things keep the white highlight.

tokens.css declares --lead-in: 214px, but serp.css overrides it with clamp(36px, 100vw - 1068px, 250px) (then max(40px, page-margin + 26px) under 1100px and 38px under 760px). The override is what renders; recorded.
Contract OWN-WORLD does not name the hard 2px listbox drop shadow (--shadow-pop); code uses it on the suggestion listbox only. Recorded, scoped to floating lists.
Token --dur-fast (100ms) is declared but never referenced; not recorded.

narrative.overview:
Webshelf looks like the web people already know. The page is plain white, links are underlined #0000ee blue, visited links turn purple and a link flashes red while it is pressed. Body text is a Times-style serif and addresses sit in plain sight in a typewriter monospace. Nothing on the reading surface is styled for its own sake. The browser era shows up only in the controls: a pale grey toolbar band across the top, sunken fields, raised buttons and grooved rules, all with square corners and lit from the top left.

The signature is the bevel grammar. **Raised** means something you press or read about (buttons, answer cards, the topic panel, the "about this result" box). **Sunken** means somewhere you type or look (the search field, inputs, image frames, the calculator display, chart wells). It is used sparingly and the same way everywhere. Dark mode keeps the structure and spacing exactly as they are and only changes the values: a charcoal page, a darker toolbar band, and the same bevels in charcoal.

The owner is a logo designer. The lockup appears exactly as drawn. In dark mode its black parts follow the ink colour and nothing else in it changes. The only brand motion is the leaning blue book in the lockup, which rocks once while results load. Images are always shown in full colour. Nothing in the product is generated by AI.
keyCharacteristics: White page, underlined blue links, purple when visited, red while pressed.
A pale grey toolbar band holds the lockup, the search field and button, and a Settings link. A grooved rule closes it.
Raised = things you press or read about. Sunken = where you type or look. Square corners everywhere.
Redaction serif for reading, its pixel cut Redaction 35 for buttons and labels, Courier Prime for addresses and readouts.
Numbered results with monospace addresses. The topic panel is a raised plate on the right on wide screens and moves to after the first result on narrower ones.
Light and dark share one structure. Images are always full colour.

rules.name: The Default Web Rule
rules.body: Links are underlined (1px, 2px offset, 2px on hover), blue, purple once visited and red while pressed. Don't restyle them as buttons or remove the underline on the reading surface.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from `assets/css/tokens.css`, which defines both themes. The only literals are the colour picker's own black, white and hue gradients, which are data rather than palette.

rules.name: The Pixel Cut Is For Controls Rule
rules.body: Redaction 35 is for button, tab and label text and small UI lines. Don't use it for reading text or headings.

rules.name: The Address In Plain Sight Rule
rules.body: Every result shows its address in Courier Prime Meta Grey, with no favicon disc or breadcrumb styling.

rules.name: The Results First Rule
rules.body: Nothing pushes the first result below the fold except an instant answer that directly answers the query. When the topic panel is not in the right track, it comes after the first result.

rules.name: The Raised Or Sunken Rule
rules.body: Something you press or read about is raised. Somewhere you type or look is sunken. Ask which one an element is before styling it, and don't give the same element both treatments.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Bevels belong on controls and cards only. Reading text, results and the page itself stay flat on white.

dos: **Do** keep the page white (#17171a in dark) and the links underlined blue, purple when visited and red while pressed.
**Do** decide raised or sunken before styling anything: raised for what you press or read about, sunken for where you type or look.
**Do** keep every corner square and every depth cue a bevel or groove.
**Do** use Redaction for reading, Redaction 35 for controls and labels, and Courier Prime for addresses and readouts.
**Do** show images in full colour, in sunken frames.
**Do** use the lockup exactly as drawn. In dark mode only its black parts change, following Ink.
**Do** keep light and dark identical in structure and spacing. Change values only, through `assets/css/tokens.css`.
**Do** name the data source on every answer card and on the topic panel.
donts: **Don't** greyscale, dither, tint or filter result or panel images. Style must never get in the way of finding an image.
**Don't** alter, recolour (beyond the black parts following Ink), crop or redraw the lockup, and never extend the shelf across the page or toolbar. The owner rejected that.
**Don't** add any motion other than the book rocking once while results load, apart from tool feedback inside an answer.
**Don't** round corners, add soft drop shadows, or put the hard listbox drop under anything except a floating list.
**Don't** bevel the reading surface. Results, snippets and prose stay flat on white.
**Don't** add an AI summary, AI tab, AI mode, or anything generated by AI.
**Don't** borrow another search engine's look; Webshelf must not read as a Google copy.
